sentence_stem: She studied hard all year, so
correct_completion: she passed the final exam with good marks.
full_sentence: She studied hard all year, so she passed the final exam with good marks.
acceptable_variants: she got a high score on the exam.
she felt proud of her results.

options.text: she had a lot of free time.
options.why_wrong: 'So' introduces a result of studying hard. Free time does not logically follow from studying all year.
This describes a memory problem, not the result of studying hard for a long time.

options.text: she passed the final exam with good marks.
she decided to stop studying forever.
options.why_wrong: This contradicts the cause-and-result pattern set up by 'studied hard all year'.

explanation: The word 'so' introduces the result of the first clause. Hard study is the cause, so the result must be a logical outcome such as passing an exam. Turkish speakers may find it natural to place the result before the connector, so practise keeping 'so' between the cause and the result.
translation: Bütün yıl çok çalıştı, bu yüzden final sınavını iyi notlarla geçti.
